name: steal time from others & be the best
desc:
welcome!!!

- kill other players to steal their time & be the person with the highest time!
- join or create a clan and contribute to make a name for you and your clan!
- buy & sell swords on the marketplace!
- take a chance opening capsules to unlock rare swords!

note: disconnecting outside of the safe-zone results in losing 25% of your time

inspired by stay alive and flex your time on others

thx for playing!!! :D
